Quaxwell

Water

Paldea · Generation 9

Quaxwell is a Water-type Practicing Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 21.5 kg. It evolves from Quaxly and into Quaquaval. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 410.
